name: Northwestern Polytechnical University
supervisors: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT)

evidence.summary: NWPU is one of the Seven Sons of National Defence, the seven universities run directly by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, which CSET found supply about three-quarters of the graduates hired by China’s defence-industry state-owned companies. NWPU specialises in aviation, space and marine fields, says it supports weapons and equipment development and core defence technologies, and hosts China’s first national key laboratory for unmanned aerial vehicles.

The US Justice Department describes NWPU as a military university heavily involved in military research that works closely with the PLA, and says it has worked on unmanned aerial and underwater vehicles and missile proliferation projects.

In a case that ended in a 2021 US guilty plea and prison sentence, at least 60 hydrophones (underwater sound sensors with anti-submarine warfare uses) were exported to NWPU in 2015–2016 without the required licences, with NWPU hidden from the manufacturer as the end user and false end-user information filed with the US government.
NWPU reports to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
